name: Range

sections.heading: Origin and explicit import
sections.text: Implicit origin: PRELUDE. Original module: std.core. Explicit alternative: import "std.core" { Range; }.explicit; --no-prelude removes implicit visibility. Import every referenced prelude name explicitly; imports grant no capability.

sections.heading: Behavior, methods and protocols
sections.text: length counts members; contains tests membership. The four Unicode endpoint forms retain their exact inclusive/exclusive meaning. Bind an iterable before using it in for.

sections.heading: Ownership and effects
sections.text: Value descriptor; iteration borrows the admitted range profile and observes each selected member once.

sections.heading: Errors and limits
sections.text: Zero step, invalid direction, overflow or unsupported scalar types reject. for does not admit an arbitrary inline expression as its iterable.

summary: A bounded integer progression with explicit endpoint policy.
title: std.prelude.Range
